moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio sh-blob, written here): Closed blob of 80 points: radius 52 px +- 20 px from smooth noise sampled around the circle; the noise time axis moves 0.5/s and loops every 4 s (sample noise on a circle in time so the last frame equals the first). Params: radius (52 px) · amp (±20 px) · loop (4 s) · seed.
